description: Which Italian comuni match: region, province, population range, purchase-price and rent ranges (OMI), population change 2019–2025, the six shortlist filters (January low, days above 30 C, regional hospital-care score, all three care scores at 60, tourist beds per resident, outside seismic zone 1) and/or the verified comuni of a tax regime. Paged (max 100) and sortable. Healthcare scores are region grain (autonomous-province grain for Bolzano and Trento): every town in the region shares the score. A comune with no price, rent, population-change, climate, healthcare, tourism or seismic figure is left out of the filter on it and COUNTED in `missingData` — never treated as cheap, free or stable; say how many were left out. The taxRegime filter lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes: a comune missing from it is NOT a 'no' (the response says so in `taxRegime.note`). Rows carry plain numbers; their source and vintage are in `figures`. Use search_comuni to turn a town name into a code, get_comune for one town's full profile.

allCareScoresAtLeast60.description: [UI key nsg60] true: the NSG prevention, community-care and hospital-care scores must all be at least 60. Region grain (autonomous-province grain for Bolzano and Trento). A comune missing any of the three is left out and counted.

excludeSeismicZone1.description: [UI key seis] true: leave out comuni in official seismic zone 1, the highest hazard class (hazard class 4 in the map layer). A legal classification from the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile (31 May 2025), not a forecast. A comune with no single classification is left out and counted.

maxBedsPerResident.description: [UI key beds] Registered tourist beds per resident (ISTAT, 2024) at most this; one of 0.1, 0.5, 1. Town grain. A comune with no figure is left out and counted; a real zero is a figure.

maxDaysAbove30C.description: [UI key heat] Average days a year above 30 C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024) at most this many, 0 to 120. Town grain. No figure: left out and counted.

maxPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive.

maxPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

maxRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

minHospitalCareScore.description: [UI key hosp] Ministero della Salute NSG 2024 hospital-care score at least this, 50 to 100; 60 is the official sufficiency line. REGION grain: every comune in a region shares its region's score, except Bolzano-province and Trento-province comuni, which carry their own autonomous province's score. No figure: left out and counted.

minJanuaryLowC.description: [UI key jan] Average January daily minimum (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024) at least this many degrees C, whole numbers -10 to 12. Town grain. A comune with no figure is left out and counted in missingData.

minPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive. A negative value means decline.

minPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

minRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

order.description: Default: desc for population, populationChange, januaryLow and hospitalCareScore; asc for name, purchasePrice, rent, daysAbove30C, bedsPerResident and seismicClass.

province.description: A province's two-letter code ("AQ") or slug ("l-aquila").

q.description: Only comuni whose name contains this (case- and accent-insensitive).

region.description: A region name or slug, e.g. "Abruzzo" or "valle-d-aosta".

sort.description: Sort key. A comune without a figure for the sort key always sorts last.

taxRegime.description: A verified geographic regime slug from /tax/regimes. Lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes; a comune missing from the list is NOT a "no" (the rule may admit comuni by routes not yet encoded).

missingData.description: One entry per figure you filtered on: how many comuni were left out for having no figure.

excluded.description: Comuni that passed every filter not about this figure but have no figure, so could not be tested and are left out. Price, rent and population change are counted against every other filter except their own and can overlap. The six shortlist filters (januaryLow, daysAbove30C, hospitalCareScore, allCareScores, bedsPerResident, seismicClass) are counted in that fixed order, each against the comuni that reached it, exactly as the /data funnel does.

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; null on the last page.

bedsPerResident.description: Registered tourist beds per resident (ISTAT, 2024). Town grain. A real zero is 0; null: no figure.

communityCareScore.description: NSG 2024 community and district care score, 0 to 100. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

daysAbove30C.description: Average days a year above 30 C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024). Town grain. null: no figure.

hospitalCareScore.description: NSG 2024 hospital-care score, 0 to 100; 60 is the official sufficiency line. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

januaryLowC.description: Average January daily minimum, C (ERA5-Land, 2015 to 2024). Town grain, nearest ~9 km grid cell. null: no figure.

nsgGrain.description: Whose NSG scores these are: the comune's region, or for Bolzano-province and Trento-province comuni their own autonomous province (scored separately, never averaged). null when the comune has no NSG score.

page.description: The comune's profile page on expatliving.it.

populationChangePct.description: Percent change 2019 to 2025; null: no figure.

preventionScore.description: NSG 2024 prevention score, 0 to 100. Grain in nsgGrain. null: no figure.

purchasePriceEurM2.description: null: no OMI price for this comune. Never a zero. OMI is Agenzia delle Entrate's official range of market values per m2, built from recorded sales and appraisals. Asking prices on listing sites are what sellers hope for, and usually run higher.

rentPriceEurM2Month.description: null: no OMI rent figure for this comune. Never a zero.

seismicClass.description: Hazard class 1 (lowest) to 4 (highest), as on the map layer. Always read it with seismicZone. null: no single classification.

seismicZone.description: The official zona sismica (1 = highest hazard), 5 minus seismicClass. A legal classification from the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile (31 May 2025), not a forecast or a verdict on any building.

taxRegime.description: Present only when taxRegime was filtered on.

qualifyingComuniInItaly.description: Size of the regime's verified set, before any other filter.

total.description: Comuni matching every filter, before paging.
